import seaborn as sns

cameras['sensor_type'] = cameras['sensor_type'].astype('category')
cameras['lens_mount'] = cameras['lens_mount'].astype('category')
cameras['body_type'] = cameras['body_type'].astype('category')

plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
